instruction: Freeze V5. Do not retrain. Compare its full content-heldout accuracy against the earlier V4 shortcut model and require no material loss, while preserving individual causal contribution from LOGIC, THINKING and INTELLIGENCE. Test combined organ ablation, four action-class slices, source/domain slices, post-corpus artifacts, safety evidence and deterministic restore. PASS only if V5 keeps the performance class of V4 without context shortcuts and remains causal in all three organs.
